java.say: `new ZooDesk()` makes the desk. As it is made, the desk also makes its three services, in its fields. The user interface never sees them.
The user interface asks for one thing: book a visit for visitor v7 on 14 November. Behind that one call, the desk works through the steps. First: is the date still free?
The ticket service answers yes. With no, the desk would stop here and answer false.
Next, the desk asks the payment service to charge the visitor.
The desk reserves the ticket for that date.
Everything worked, so the desk answers true.
Back in the user interface. It made one call and only knows ZooDesk. The desk knew which services to call, and in which order.
